a: Ichinose, a blonde Class B beauty, who coolly argues the fight does not concern her only because she wants to use the library and threatens to report them, shaming both sides into standing down.

a: He bows to Horikita and offers to take a break from basketball club activities for the remaining week so he can study properly.
